milestone: WP04/06 native strategy benchmark execution foundations
implemented: Separate strict strategy execution plan with common/strategy capability manifests and journal-bound model-call/output/Goal-round limits.
Cell-wide preflight reservation/settlement meter with actual native foreground, parent and child coverage; unknown reservations retained.
Real private Delivery/Policy/JSONL owner bootstrap, explicit empty-session header materialization, local reply capture and cancellation.
Public benchmark strategy API and service-free Delivery types entry; clean two-package bootstrap.
limits: No strategy-v1 executor or CLI suite, actual capability attestation, isolated corpus/Verifier assembly, immutable per-cell runtime evidence store, observed-only meter mode, or real-model efficacy comparison yet.
Meter traces are process-local observations; tests use deterministic adapters, not paid providers.
Owner shutdown cancels native agents but has no independent stop deadline; a future executor must preserve unknown for non-cooperative cleanup and stop subsequent cells.
Directory modes and tool restrictions are not an OS sandbox against same-UID Host code.
